objective: Show the maximum vertical distance between the Terrarium DEM and Cloud DEM in the viewer interface.

comparison_models: Terrarium DEM at the selected LoD
Cloud DEM sampled onto the selected Terrarium grid

inputs: Cloud DEM sampled on the selected Terrarium grid
outputs: Viewer status entry: Max vertical distance

geospatial_data.crs_inference: Terrarium tiles are Web Mercator and Cloud DEM sampling is performed into the same viewer grid.
geospatial_data.validity_mask: finite Cloud DEM and finite Terrarium DEM samples on the selected Terrarium grid

visualization.downsampling: None added for this metric beyond the selected viewer grid.
